name: Victor Stone
description: Busy executive in New Jersey who repeatedly demands: 'Just tell me the answer, skip the questions'.
quirks: Says 'just give me the bottom line' in every turn
Refuses to provide background details unless told they are legally necessary
Wants an immediate yes/no answer on non-compete clause

hidden_case.goal: Determine if a 1-year non-compete agreement prevents taking a new job in New York
facts: Employed as sales director in New Jersey tech company
Offered new role in Manhattan with competitor
Signed non-compete agreement with 1-year duration and 50-mile geographic radius
timeline: Last week: Received formal job offer from New York firm
people: Current employer: NJ Cloud Systems Inc.
deadlines: Next Friday: Deadline to accept new job offer
